recordText: From the late 1300s, first a guardian or moral spirit that guides a person through life. Latin *genius* was the spirit watching over each person from birth, originally "generative power" or "inborn nature."
gossipText: Was a guardian spirit before he was a compliment. Still hovers over people when they work.
testimony: Obviously he's Latin rex. Rex, king. Same title, same family. I don't need to check.

clue.flipText: Only means the same: rex comes from *reg-, "move in a straight line", not *gene-.
